title.zh: 广义等离子体色散函数七类分布
title.en: Evaluate all seven original generalized distribution selectors.

summary: Evaluate all seven original generalized distribution selectors.

identity.definition: Selector densities: delta(v); f=1 on [-.5,.5]; max(0,1-|v|); sqrt(2)/pi/(1+v²/2)²; H(v-.1)exp(-v²)/sqrt(pi); and 3sqrt(3)/(4pi)/(1+|v|³) on |v|<=4. For a jump J at a, Zp includes J/(a-z). Top-hat density sign and incomplete-Maxwellian cutoff jump are corrected from the inconsistent source. Gaussian derivative uses cancellation-free raw susceptibility/moments at large phase rather than subtracting a rounded unit term. Far top-hat values use a convergent inverse-power series; derivatives form real and imaginary denominator components separately before reciprocal evaluation, preserving representable small contour components. Near the center the real response uses real log1p, near edges log-hypot differences, and contour phase uses a single atan2; no complex log1p is used.
identity.direction: Declared inputs to declared scientific outputs
identity.coordinates: Dimensionless real velocity and complex phase or frequency
identity.boundary: Infinite real velocity contour with stated continuation or finite support.
assumptions: Density is real and integrable on the real contour.
No collective-mode uniqueness or certified global quadrature bound is asserted.

inputs.name: z
inputs.description: Complex phase point z=omega/(sqrt(2)*k) for the Maxwellian normalization.

inputs.name: selector
inputs.description: 0 analytic expression/Maxwellian; 1 delta at zero; 2 positive unit top-hat [-.5,.5]; 3 triangle [-1,1]; 4 normalized gamma n=2,vt=1; 5 H(v-.1) exp(-v²)/sqrt(pi); 6 truncated slowing-down |v|<=4.

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: Analytic density in v using finite real constants, pi, arithmetic and exp/log/sqrt/sin/cos/sinh/cosh/tanh; MATLAB point operators accepted.
inputs.constraints: Real integrable density with decaying derivative; no arbitrary code, comparisons, attributes or indexing.

inputs.name: integration_mesh
inputs.description: Feature-resolving finite increasing velocity mesh; infinite tails are also integrated.
inputs.constraints: All material features resolved; no unresolved tail features.

outputs.name: Z
outputs.description: Integral f(v)/(v-z) dv with the declared continuation.

supported: All original selectors 0 through 6, including exact delta/top-hat and cutoff derivative jumps.
Analytic Maxwellian, gamma and custom expressions with Landau continuation; real-contour piecewise distributions in either half plane.
Upper real-axis boundary values away from endpoints and triangular derivative corners.
excluded: Arbitrary symbolic expressions or executable input.
Guessed analytic continuation of discontinuous distributions.
Silent fallback from unknown selector to Maxwellian.
preconditions: Density is real and integrable on the real contour.
No collective-mode uniqueness or certified global quadrature bound is asserted.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid, nonfinite or singular declared inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Callback arithmetic failures propagate; nonrepresentable transform raises ValueError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: RuntimeError for Cauchy, real-axis or principal-value quadrature nonconvergence, or root nonconvergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial scientific result is returned after failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Reimplements the defining scientific relations exposed by frozen GPDF D1; D2 corrections and failure history are documented in gpdf-generalized-core evaluation. Dev9 successor of exact document SHA256 77ec7f6dc98a03e99bb1b463cd1a734e3b7dcf23e1c4a3ebcecaf0902a82150f; unchanged contracts are reused, changed numerical methods and failure closure follow GPDF-R1/R2/R3.
provenance.license_status: Independent equation implementation uses NumPy and SciPy; their licenses are carried with the selected distribution.
public_references: Hua-Sheng Xie, Generalized plasma dispersion function, Phys. Plasmas. 20 (2013), 092125 (scientific context)

scope: All original selectors 0 through 6, including exact delta/top-hat and cutoff derivative jumps.
Analytic Maxwellian, gamma and custom expressions with Landau continuation; real-contour piecewise distributions in either half plane.
Upper real-axis boundary values away from endpoints and triangular derivative corners.

Independent Gaussian squared-kernel and high-precision derivative checks at large phase and asymptotic transitions; top-hat direct integral/series, center/edge/real-axis branches and tiny derivative components with zero absolute tolerances.
known_limitations: Selector 5 retains incomplete mass; selector 6 retains upstream finite-cutoff normalization.
Piecewise lower-plane response is the real-contour transform, not an inferred analytic continuation.
Named fixed selectors retain original physical parameters; this API does not add arbitrary shape parameters.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent defining integrals, analytic residues, distributional jumps, all four complete default scans and 50-digit independent root equations are source-level numerical evidence. Actual installed-wheel evidence is recorded separately in the frozen delivery receipts.

example.description: 广义等离子体色散函数七类分布的可执行例子
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.generalized_dispersion import evaluate_generalized_dispersion
r=evaluate_generalized_dispersion(1j,2)
assert r['Z'].imag>0
assert np.isfinite(r['Zp'])
example.expected: Assertions verify the stated output property.
